text:
alma: Heads-up  NimbusPay case study: want a 1530s quote + a 10m interview clip for the launch post and a short webinar promo. Target publish June 22. Who's available to record next week?

ryan: Mornings are best. I'll join to ask product impact Qs.

dina: Legal requirement: signed release before publish, and quote approval pre-social. If you plan to use numbers we need Research backup. Post quote draft here.

omar: I ran benchmarks on NimbusPays workload. Median token cost dropped ~2.4x vs their legacy infra. Can validate if you want exact phrasing.

tariq: For leads, route webinar signups to SFDC campaign 'NimbusPay Launch Jun' and assign to SDR queue 'Fintech-MidMarket'. Add hidden fields for utm_source/utm_campaign.

asset-bot: Intake ticket created: asset-18722. Checklist: schedule recording, upload signed release, attach benchmark, approve quote, add UTM + SFDC mapping.

alma: Draft quote: "Redwood cut our inference costs by nearly 3x and let us ship new merchant features faster." Thoughts?

omar: Based on the tests, say "~2.4x" or "nearly 2.5x". Legal will allow "nearly 3x" only if we publish the benchmark link and method note.

dina: Prefer conservative phrasing. If Research uploads the CSV + methods, legal will approve "~2.4x" or "nearly 3x" with a parenthetical link. I'll attach the release template and quick redlines.

ryan: Alternate social caption (no number): "Significantly lower inference costs + faster merchant rollouts."

tariq: Ops note: when mapping forms to SFDC, set CampaignMemberStatus='Registered' and populate custom fields: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign. I'll add mapping to the intake ticket.

alma: Proposed recording: Tue 6/13 9:00am PT, 25m block (tech check + recording). I'll drop the pre-interview brief and consent form into the ticket.

dina: I'll review the signed release if it's uploaded before the call.

omar: I'll upload the benchmark CSV + README tonight and paste the link here.

alma: Great  locking time now. Will include UTM spec and the SFDC campaign name in the calendar invite. Thanks :sparkles:
